title: Sales agent: semantic model for Dynamics 365 and Salesforce CRM data
notes: claim 91: severity blocker on a rationale: impact rating lowered to minor; ratings are judgements and cannot hold a page
the verifier wrote "hold" but listed no blocker and fewer than three majors; the claims decide, so the page is not held
summary: Hold: the impact rationale says nobody beyond Sales agent users and its administrators is affected, but the shared model also changes Copilot in Dynamics 365 Sales. The documented controls, default-enablement qualifications, licensing statements and conflicting rollout dates are otherwise supported.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans a semantic model giving Sales agent the structure and meaning of CRM data.
claims.quote: Semantic model helps Sales Agent understand the structure and meaning of an organization’s CRM data.

claims.claim: The planned model covers tables or objects, fields, descriptions, data types, relationships, views, pick-list values and glossary terms.
claims.quote: It creates a connected representation of CRM metadata, including tables or objects, fields, descriptions, data types, relationships, views, pick-list values, and glossary terms.

claims.claim: Sales agent can retrieve this context to interpret business language and answer questions spanning related CRM records.
claims.quote: Sales Agent can retrieve this context when responding to questions, improving its ability to interpret business language and answer complex questions that span related CRM records.

claims.claim: The roadmap says Dynamics 365 administrators enable the model in the Power Apps maker portal.
claims.quote: Dynamics 365 admins can enable and turn on semantic model in Power Apps Maker Portal

claims.claim: The roadmap says Dynamics 365 administrators configure the model's data coverage and signals.
claims.quote: configure the data coverage and signals that Sales Agent should use. Admins can configure the underlying data, views, metadata and relationships used in the model.

claims.claim: For Salesforce, the roadmap bases the model on existing Sales agent table and glossary configuration.
claims.quote: For Salesforce customers, the semantic model will be based on existing Sales agent table and glossary configuration in Sales agent settings or Power Apps Maker Portal.

claims.claim: The roadmap says Salesforce administrators can configure additional relationships and views in the maker portal.
claims.quote: In Power Apps Maker Portal, Salesforce admins will can configure additional Salesforce signals to use in semantic model such as relationships and views.

claims.claim: The model extracts existing relationships, views, forms, description summaries and optionally sample data rows.
claims.quote: The semantic model automatically extracts signals from metadata that already exists in your Dataverse environment - table relationships, views, forms, column description summaries, and optionally sample data rows.

claims.claim: Sample data rows are disabled by default.

claims.claim: Enabling Sample table rows allows the system to read sample data rows.
claims.quote: When enabled, the system uses sample data to read and extract the metadata contained in the sample data rows.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment; Governance guidance
claims.claim: The model automatically regenerates every 12 hours.
claims.quote: The semantic model regenerates automatically every 12 hours to reflect schema changes.

claims.claim: An administrator can trigger manual regeneration instead of waiting for the scheduled cycle.
claims.quote: you can trigger a manual regeneration instead of waiting for the next scheduled run.

claims.claim: Initial model generation can take up to two hours.
claims.quote: Initial generation can take up to two hours, and incremental changes typically take up to 30 minutes.

claims.claim: Nobody beyond sellers using Sales agent and the administrators and makers configuring their environment is affected.
claims.quote: Impact rationale: "Nobody else is affected." Risk assessment: "Sales agent and Copilot in Dynamics 365 Sales share the SalesSpecificQnA model, so a change for one applies to both."
claims.fix: Remove "Nobody else is affected." from the impact rationale. The body correctly states that model changes also apply to Copilot in Dynamics 365 Sales, as verified at https://learn.microsoft.com/power-apps/maker/data-platform/fine-tune-semantic-model-signals. Keep the medium impact rating.
